title: GEN5 RTX 5060 NCU-Profiled Release
highlights: FP8 cuBLASLt: 137.9 TFLOPS at 4096^3 (30.43x vs FP16 WMMA)
FP8 cuBLASLt: 97.6 TFLOPS at 2048^3 (21.84x vs FP16 WMMA)
Inference kernel SM 120 WMMA: 5.81 TFLOPS at 1024^3 (4.6x vs naive)
ncu profiles: FP8 fallback (DRAM-bound 0.9% peak, tensor 12-15%), FP16 async-8warp (SM throughput 44%)
Correctness tests: all PASS at 256^3, 1024^3, 4096^3 (FP16 abs, FP8 exact, cross-kernel consistency)
Triple-buffer: disabled (1.5-1.85x slower due to shared memory pressure on SM 120)
Bug fixes: lane-worker blocked routing, artifact-resolver traversal check, verification-domain temporal gate

ncu_evidence.note: .ncu-rep files are gitignored (binary, 3-76MB). CSV exports are tracked.

convergence.claim: v0.2.0 release: GEN5 WMMA GEMM fully profiled with ncu on RTX 5060. FP8 input -> FP16 WMMA fallback with HMMA activity via cuBLASLt achieves 137.9 TFLOPS at 4096^3. Custom FP16 WMMA peaks at 6.53 TFLOPS. All ncu evidence requirements met. Correctness verified at 3 sizes.
